name: Complex Video Reasoning and Robustness Evaluation Suite (CVRR-ES)
description: CVRR-ES is a benchmark designed to comprehensively assess Video Large Multi-modal Models (Video-LMMs) across 11 diverse real-world video dimensions, focusing on reasoning capabilities and robustness to user prompt variations in complex video understanding tasks.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark for video-LMM robustness and reasoning that is gaining attention in the multimodal evaluation community.
notes: Focuses on complex video reasoning and robustness; evaluates 11 recent Video-LMMs; includes a training-free prompting technique to improve performance.
